instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: Metrics Analysis and the Metrics Programme

questions.question: Which pitfall describes people changing behaviour to fit the metric?
questions.question_ar: أي خلل يصف تغيير الناس سلوكهم ليطابق المقياس؟
options: Brooks' Law here now
measurement dysfunction
the Pareto principle
software entropy too
options_en: Brooks' Law here now
measurement dysfunction
the Pareto principle
software entropy too
questions.explanation: When a measure becomes a target, people optimise the number rather than the goal.
questions.explanation_ar: عندما يصبح المقياس هدفاً، يحسّن الناس الرقم بدل الهدف.

questions.question: What does correlation between two metrics show?
options: neither can be measured here again
they move together to some degree
one causes the other too now too
both are wrong here now again
options_ar: أن أياً منهما لا يُقاس هنا
أن كليهما خطأ هنا الآن مجدداً
options_en: neither can be measured here again
they move together to some degree
one causes the other too now too
both are wrong here now again
questions.explanation: Correlation shows association only; causation needs more evidence.
questions.explanation_ar: الارتباط يُظهر المصاحبة فقط، والسببية تحتاج دليلاً أكثر.

questions.question: What is regression used for on metric data?
questions.question_ar: فيمَ يُستخدم الانحدار على بيانات المقاييس؟
options: to rename columns now again here too
to sort the rows here here again again
to model how one variable tracks another
to delete outliers too now too now here here
options_en: to rename columns now again here too
to sort the rows here here again again
to model how one variable tracks another
to delete outliers too now too now here here
questions.explanation: A regression line estimates the expected value of one metric from another.
questions.explanation_ar: خط الانحدار يقدّر القيمة المتوقعة لمقياس من مقياس آخر.

questions.question: Why does an outlier matter in metric analysis?
questions.question_ar: لماذا يهم الشاذ في تحليل المقاييس؟
options: it proves the metric is wrong
it must always be deleted
it has no effect here now
it can distort the average
options_en: it proves the metric is wrong
it must always be deleted
it has no effect here now
it can distort the average
questions.explanation: One extreme module can pull a mean far from what most modules do.
questions.explanation_ar: وحدة متطرفة واحدة قد تسحب المتوسط بعيداً عما تفعله معظم الوحدات.

questions.question: What does theoretical validation of a metric check?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يفحص التحقق النظري من المقياس؟
options: that it obeys the properties it claims
that it compiles here here too now
that users like it too now again again
that it is cheap now again here too
options_ar: أنه رخيص هنا أيضاً هنا مجدداً
options_en: that it obeys the properties it claims
that it compiles here here too now
that users like it too now again again
that it is cheap now again here too
questions.explanation: A metric must satisfy the measurement-theory properties it assumes, such as scale type.
questions.explanation_ar: المقياس يجب أن يحقق خصائص نظرية القياس التي يفترضها، مثل نوع المقياس.

questions.question: What does empirical validation check?
options: that the tool is installed here too
that the metric predicts what it should
that the code compiles now again again here
that the team agrees here too now here
options_ar: أن الأداة منصّبة أيضاً الآن هنا أيضاً
أن المقياس يتنبأ بما يجب أن يتنبأ به
أن الكود يُترجم هنا مجدداً مجدداً
أن الفريق يوافق الآن هنا أيضاً الآن
options_en: that the tool is installed here too
that the metric predicts what it should
that the code compiles now again again here
that the team agrees here too now here
questions.explanation: Empirical validation compares the metric against outcomes observed in real projects.
questions.explanation_ar: التحقق التجريبي يقابل المقياس بنتائج مرصودة في مشاريع حقيقية.

questions.question: Why is consistent data collection essential?
options: it speeds the compiler now here too now here
it lowers the budget here again again again too here
inconsistent collection makes comparisons invalid
it reduces the code size too now here too now
options_ar: يقلل حجم الكود الآن هنا أيضاً
options_en: it speeds the compiler now here too now here
it lowers the budget here again again again too here
inconsistent collection makes comparisons invalid
it reduces the code size too now here too now
questions.explanation: If two periods are counted differently, any trend between them is an artefact.
questions.explanation_ar: إذا عُدّت فترتان بطرق مختلفة، فكل اتجاه بينهما مصطنع.

questions.question: What is the first step of a metrics programme?
questions.question_ar: ما أول خطوة في برنامج قياس؟
options: install the biggest tool now here
collect everything possible again
publish a dashboard here too now too here
state the goal the metrics must serve
options_ar: تنصيب أكبر أداة هنا مجدداً مجدداً
جمع كل شيء ممكن الآن هنا أيضاً
نشر لوحة مؤشرات أيضاً الآن هنا
options_en: install the biggest tool now here
collect everything possible again
publish a dashboard here too now too here
state the goal the metrics must serve
questions.explanation: Goals come first, because a metric without a question behind it is just noise.
questions.explanation_ar: الأهداف أولاً، فالمقياس بلا سؤال وراءه مجرد ضجيج.
